title: Recordum plugin manifest
description: Canonical schema for the manifest.json shipped inside a .rmpk plugin package. See docs/plugin-api.md and docs/superpowers/specs/2026-05-13-plugin-system-design.md §2.

schema_version.description: Version of this manifest schema. Currently only "1" is recognized.

id.description: Reverse-DNS identifier of the plugin (e.g. io.recordum.chart-engine).

name.description: Human-readable plugin name in the marketplace and settings.

type.description: Package type. Defaults to "Plugin". Phase 7+ may surface "Template" / "Theme".

publisher.description: Publisher identity. Verified by the marketplace via the publisher's GitHub identity claim.

min_recordum_version.description: Minimum Recordum app version required to load this plugin (semver).

description_key.description: Resource key in locales/<lang>.json for the plugin's marketplace description.

icon.description: Path within the package to the plugin icon (PNG or SVG). Relative to the package root.

entry.description: Path within the package to the JavaScript entry point. Relative to the package root.

permissions.description: Static (install-time) capabilities declared by the plugin. Sandbox enforces these; the user is shown them in the install dialog.

network.description: Host whitelist for outbound HTTPS via recordum.network.fetch(). Use "*" to request unrestricted access (triggers a red-flag warning). localhost and private IPs are always denied.

notifications.description: Whether the plugin may post local notifications via recordum.ui.notify().

filesystem.description: Filesystem access level. "PluginStorage" is implicit (10 MB cap); "AttachmentsRead" allows reading user attachments; "UserPick" requires a user-initiated picker each time.

ai.description: AI access level. "Local" allows local-only inference using on-device models. Plugins never bypass the global ai_data_sharing filter (see spec §4.6).

extension_points.description: Well-known extension point IDs the plugin contributes to (e.g. "chart.renderer", "dashboard.widget").

source_url.description: Optional public source repository. Required to earn the Open Source badge (the marketplace CI also requires an OSI-approved LICENSE file at the URL).

supported_locales.description: ISO 639-1 codes the plugin ships translations for under locales/<lang>.json.
